properties.name: reflow2.toml's own version string moved 0.26.1 to 0.27.0 as step 1 of the release cut. The design meaning of a cut lives in rel:v0270 and epoch:v0270, not in a version string, so the design holds unchanged. This drift is expected on EVERY cut: reflow2.toml is the only registered artifact the version bump touches (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and AGENTS.md are not registered).
